10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back. Settle to just under critical power after the hard start; keep pod reserve (w_bal_pod_frac) above about 0.3 until the last 2 km. Spend a bit more on legs against the current/wind, a bit less with it. Watch for drag incidents (speed drops at same power: push_local_mps falls) and instrument drift (pod vs boat power disagreeing). Final sprint from about 1000-1500 m to go if reserve allows. Re-check calibration around 10-15 min: if reserve holds steady above CP, CP is underestimated.

10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back (north legs odd, current helps about +0.13 m/s; south legs even, against). Paddler blew up at min 2 after a hard start; calibration (pod CP 202 W, 12.1 kJ) looks right. Hold pod power about 195-205 W (just under/at CP) with no surges. Target ground pace: north legs about 150-152 s/500, south legs about 162-164 s/500 (CP water pace about 156). Re-cue the pace right after each turn because the paddler keeps chasing the old target through turns. Watch for drag incidents (push_local minus push_along drops) and pod drift. Final push from about 1500 m to go if pod reserve has refilled; sprint (finish) last 400-500 m.

arguments.text: Min 9.4: POD DRIFT suspected. From race_s ~465 the pod shaft power slid steadily 205 -> 159 W (about -0.45 W/s, still falling) while boat-model power stayed 126-128 W, GPS speed 3.05 and stroke rate 66 unchanged. So pod reads low and pod reserve (w_bal_pod_frac) and push_local_mps are now unreliable (too optimistic). Use boat power_w (CP 130 W) and reserve_left_pct, stroke rate, and paddler feel instead. Boat numbers fold current into effort: compare same-direction legs via legs().

10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back (odd legs north, current helps about +0.13 m/s; even legs south, against about -0.13). Paddler blew up at min 2 after a hard start; calibration looked right then. POD UNRELIABLE from min 7.8 (reads low, drifting); judge effort by boat power_w (CP 130 W, aim 126-132 W), reserve_left_pct, stroke rate (66 at CP) and paddler feel (8/10 at CP). Ground pace at CP: north legs about 150, south legs about 163-164 s/500; re-cue pace right after each turn (paddler chases old target through turns). Watch for drag incidents: speed drop at same rate and feel. Final push from about 1500 m to go if boat reserve above about 40 pct; sprint (finish) last 400-500 m.
